findings.detail: Tool "postal" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: web_read, web_search, web_render, msg_box, msg_inbox, agents_readiness, email_validate, federal_register_search, clinical_trials_search, deps_check, deps_audit, company_br · Private data: token_verdict, msg_box, agents_readiness, dns, domain, web_tables, sec_filings, federal_register_search, deps_audit, company_br, crypto_price, text_redact, solana_swap_order, solana_swap_execute, evm_swap_order, evm_swap_execute, bridge_order, bridge_execute, hyperliquid_account, hyperliquid_prepare, hyperliquid_submit, empresas · Public sink: msg_send, guard_injection, dns, domain, email_validate, deps_check, company_br, postal, text_redact, solana_swap_execute, hyperliquid_prepare, hyperliquid_submit, empresas_buscar · Destructive: text_redact, solana_swap_order, solana_swap_execute, evm_swap_execute, bridge_execute.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
